ForgeMCP 0.2.17 — Landscape operational validation

Checked October 24, 2026. Verdict: BLOCKED — CURRENT TERRAIN DIFFERS FROM THE PRESERVED TWO-EXTENSION BASELINE. This is a controlled read-only review. No preview, terrain edit, save, reload, Editor launch, plugin build, or Trello update was performed.

Live connection and tools

Fresh ForgeMCP discovery found one responsive Unreal session: unreal-33500, PID 33500 (the historical unreal-43744 is not assumed current). Native health reports UE 5.6.1-44394996+++UE5+Release-5.6 and ForgeMCP 0.2.17-alpha.1. unreal_project_info confirms [local path], /Game/Levels/L_City_World_Master.L_City_World_Master, PIE stopped. A native Landscape inspection succeeds.

The Codex catalog currently exposes callable unreal_inspect_landscape, unreal_read_landscape_height_region, unreal_preview_landscape, unreal_apply_landscape, job status/cancel, edit-session preflight/request/status/revoke, and dirty-package inspection. Tool schemas advertise raise, lower, flatten, smooth, generate, apply_heightmap, and coastline, plus layer/setup and explicit save/reload previews. frame and World Partition load_region/unload_region are also schema actions. These are implemented interfaces, not live proof that every action succeeds on this production World Partition Landscape. The existing saved riverbed and two extensions provide historical evidence for bounded lower/smooth-style sculpting; no hill, mountain, valley, plateau, coast, or heightmap result is claimed here. Terrain shape categories use these primitives and require separate previews/approval/tests.

Current terrain and safety finding

Landscape GUID BD45FDD94EC2A29617B50794F2DE4E9D, dimension 2041 × 2041, World Partition enabled. All 16 streaming proxies resolve in the active world; 64 Landscape and 64 collision components are registered. The Landscape reports clean and layers up to date. Original Layer GUID 198824024FF8A77A01535B86021D9B34 retains full-height MD5 9f43572fbc2c06ef497da015879cdb23, 0/0 cm. ForgeTerrain GUID 2E6FC5F94C4EF704F700299B5D08C23B now reports full-height MD5 f5a8d55a3372fefe6fcadb0e7ff25b07, minimum -100 cm.

The previous approved two-extension baseline was ForgeTerrain MD5 08cbe382a59441d8148a674cf0d83851. Fresh bounded native read of [1042,1065,1098,1075] returned 627 layer samples with MD5 0bce98df53283065e7a173d2d0c56d73, versus saved baseline 3817bd2c18535a9b4529387de493f2b9. Exact array comparison found 24 of 627 differences: every sample at x=1085–1096, y=1070–1071 that previously had a negative carved value now reads 0 cm. The other 603 samples in that bounded region match. The full-height hash also differs, so changes elsewhere are possible and were not enumerated by this bounded comparison. This evidence does not establish whether the two newly mentioned indentations were intentional, where they lie, or why the 24 prior values differ. No cause or authorization is inferred.

A complete native loaded-package inventory inspected 1,192 packages, with no errors, limit hit, or further pages. Only compiled-in engine /Script/SlateCore is dirty; zero loaded production Content packages are dirty. That does not prove unloaded packages clean. The affected streaming-proxy file currently exists at 610,905 bytes, SHA-256 40fe8daa2c0a88bbea0e9cc33a97ec639dc99b53a2c23d673febb46c0047fd3d, last written 2026-10-24T01:55:36.2133544Z; the October 23 saved baseline was 609,966 bytes, SHA-256 01bcd92c87e93b000811a863b88701ec845ff0e7487c868f0ccb92a46a955b61. The root actor package is 5,063 bytes and retains SHA-256 9455276756f9b78c36e6c7fc732cadf4b3a486ab9d2237c81917d4677e3022df, with a later write timestamp. These are disk-byte observations, not independent deserialization or proof of intended height contents. The new file write and clean flags do not explain or approve the 24-vertex change.

Because preservation of the prior extensions is a stated requirement, no non-destructive terrain preview was run. A preview would be against an unresolved new baseline and would not repair or prove persistence. The existing riverbed is present by the -100 cm layer minimum and bounded carved samples, but exact preservation of both earlier extension arrays fails the current check. The two indentations cannot be identified from the supplied baseline without their intended coordinates and expected heights.

Independent reload route, prepared only

The last approved isolated launch is consumed. Its ordinary rendered startup with -Unattended and private user/DDC paths reached a TedsOutliner/unloaded-LevelEditor assertion before target-map authentication. Retained evidence supports the module-order failure; it does not show that -Unattended or the private user settings caused it. Normal interactive startup without -Unattended is a minimal hypothesis to test, not a proven workaround. Keep Fab, EditorDataStorageFeatures and ForgeMCP enabled, and do not patch or rebuild them for this route.

A future separately authorized single attempt should use a fresh physical isolated project copy of the now-agreed saved source, never reuse the previous launch marker/plan. Before launch, record a new expected full-height and bounded sample baseline and resolve the 24-vertex discrepancy; hash every production source and clone file, audit checkpoint pins, dirty packages, identity, resources, private DDC graphs/fallbacks and writable paths. Use the installed Editor executable with the isolated .uproject and target map, ordinary rendered interactive startup, private registration/user/temp/log/DDC paths, autosave disabled in the clone, and no -Unattended. Preserve source/clone separation and all logs. Bind one approval ID to the exact command, plan hash and maximum 900-second startup window; one launch, no retry.

The controller must retain root process handle, creation time, executable, exact clone command line and parent/worker identities; explicitly exclude the current production PID. Monitor private DDC selection, startup progress, prompts, assertions and timeout. Stop only a conclusively identity-verified disposable root and owned workers; if identity cannot be established, leave the process untouched for manual handling. Retain generated files rather than automatically cleaning or rolling back. On success, authenticate the private ForgeMCP session, prove target map and Landscape identity, compare both full-layer hashes and exact protected bounded arrays, 16 proxies and 64/64 components, then capture close-up joins and read-only collision-height evidence where supported. Finally reauthenticate production and rehash source/checkpoints. An interactive process start alone is not a reload PASS.

The future acceptance sequence is: confirm current sculpt intent and baseline; prove native current-memory readbacks and save-log/file evidence; load a separately copied saved project; authenticate its own session; read Landscape heights independently from disk; compare riverbed, both extensions and indentations; verify production/Engine preservation. No modification or save is required for this verification step. A new sculpt/save demonstration would need separate exact-scope edit-session approval and separate save authorization.

Next Landscape demonstration

After resolving this blocker and passing independent reload, start with a small controlled hill on a reviewed flat ForgeTerrain region outside all protected riverbed/indentation bounds. Exact vertices must be chosen from a fresh bounded height read and World Partition ownership check; none are approved now. Use native unreal_landscape_edit_session_preflight, a bounded raise preview with halo and predicted heights, then a separately owner-approved edit session and apply. Read every modified vertex and surrounding guard ring, Original Layer MD5, proxy/collision status, and dirty packages. Save only the exact Landscape-owned packages under separate owner approval, preserve the pre-edit recovery checkpoint, then independently reload a disposable copy and compare disk-backed heights. A safe rollback strategy is to preserve the checkpoint and stop on failure; no automatic restoration is authorized.

Additional proposed demonstrations can use the same boundary: mountain ridge (raise across adjacent bounded regions), valley (lower), further riverbed extension (lower plus smooth), coastal slope (coastline preview), and smoothing refinement (smooth). Each requires a freshly selected region, exact preview and guard-ring review, one explicitly scoped editing grant, separate save approval, and independent reload acceptance. None is performed or approved here.

Minimum next decision: establish whether the 24 zeroed vertices and the new full-height hash reflect owner-intended terrain changes. If intended, record coordinates and exact expected samples for both indentations and create a new approved saved-source baseline. If unintended, stop for a separately authorized preservation/recovery plan. Only after that evidence can a new single-attempt isolated reload plan be put up for owner launch approval. Stage 2E and Phase 6C remain unaccepted.
